verdict.rationale: Slate is documented only as an npm-installed CLI/TUI agent. The evidence never mentions a desktop app or visual diff review. Its TUI grid of subagent cards and `/sessions` switching are an adjacent terminal feature, not side-by-side sessions in a desktop app, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app
